title: CALM View (POC draft — NOT a standard)
description: Draft meta-schema for a CALM view: a named, audience-tagged selection over one architecture. Filter only — no presentation properties (layout, pins, colors, themes are out of scope by design; see finos/architecture-as-code#3552). POC for finos/architecture-as-code#2344. Provisional pending #3624 (reference format). suggested-formats is a non-normative hint only: any renderer may ignore it.

$schema.description: Reference to this meta-schema (convention; also lets content detectors route by keyword).

description.description: What question this view answers, and for whom.

audience.description: Stakeholder roles this view serves (cf. ISO 42010 stakeholder). Free strings; no LDAP mapping (future work).

suggested-formats.description: Non-normative presentation hint for this view's readers (e.g. svg for managers, json for developers, markdown as compliance record). Renderers may ignore it; renderer-neutrality holds.

group.description: Editorial folder for view pickers (e.g. a LikeC4-style list). Free text; views without group list under Ungrouped. Organization only, never selection semantics.

derived-from.description: Provenance for derived views (frozen snapshot, re-derivable). Absent on hand-authored views. Carries no intent: intent lives in custom views only.

drill-down.description: Navigation within one model: node unique-id to the unique-id of another sidecar over the same architecture. Opening it replaces the canvas content; it never edits the model. Renderers link to the target (Markdown and SVG); validators require the target to exist with the same `for`.

for.description: One-way reference(s) to the architecture(s) this view selects from. A single path (provisional semantics: relative to this file's directory, pending finos/architecture-as-code#3624) or an array of paths for a multi-file view: each file resolves independently, ids are namespaced per file, no dedup is claimed.

architecture.description: unique-id of the architecture this view selects from. Lets a view match a document that has no $id (for example one uploaded to CALM Hub).

filter.description: Inclusion selectors. A node is in the view if its unique-id is listed in 'nodes', its node-type is listed in 'node-types', or its metadata matches every key of 'metadata' (value in the listed values). A relationship is in the view if listed in 'relationships', or if all its endpoints are in the view (closure). Endpoints outside the view lift to the nearest visible container (composed-of / deployed-in ancestry); relationships that cannot lift to distinct visible endpoints stay excluded with reason. Flows and decorators resolve by unique-id against sibling documents.

metadata.description: Node metadata match: the node is in the view when, for every key, its metadata value is one of the listed values.

controls.description: Control claim match: the node or relationship is in the view when it carries one of the listed control keys in 'controls'.
